comment: Layer-C integration cases for centered_2nd_deriv_nonuniform_vertical. Uses the field-level pipeline (build_ode_problem) to time-integrate du/dt = d2u/dz2 on a 1D non-uniform vertical column with zero Dirichlet BCs and verify O(h^2) spatial convergence. The per-cell width array dz[k] is declared as a state variable in the ESM and injected by _inject_grids! from the GDD levels field.
